snippet.title: BoobyRogue: Tumor Takedown – Official Teaser
snippet.description:
Dive into a fast-paced roguelite like no other!
Play as Booby, a fearless heroine fighting a symbolic battle against breast cancer in a stylized, fun, and action-packed universe.

⚔️ 50 unique playable characters with their own abilities
💥 Hundreds of item combinations for endless builds
🔁 Massive replayability with over 30 hours of content
🎥 Streamer-friendly mode so you can go live without worries

Get ready for intense 30-minute runs full of energy, variety, and surprises.
The fight begins soon… are you ready to take on the challenge?

Wishlist on Steam:
